issues.detail: Threads TH3, TH4, and TH5 contain 14 messages each, which is below the minimum required of 16 messages per thread.
The text contains forbidden terms: 'score' (in M2, M25, M65) and 'performance' (in M66).

Participants 61317 and 66412 have very robotic, brief, and repetitive message structures (e.g., 'Ok, I will schedule that', 'The dashboard looks good to me', 'Good progress team') lacking distinct professional personas compared to the rest of the group.
